rfrg-01-c3.text: Eusebius of Caesarea (trans. A. C. McGiffert) (c. 324). Ecclesiastical History, Book 1, chapter 13. Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 2, vol. 1 (New Advent edition).
rfrg-01-c3.quote: the epistles themselves which we have taken from the archives and have literally translated from the Syriac language in the following manner.
rfrg-01-c3.claim: reproduces two letters he says he translated from Syriac records in the archives of Edessa

rfrg-05-c1.text: Rebecca Denova (2021). Flavius Josephus. World History Encyclopedia.
rfrg-05-c1.quote: In describing the rule of the procurator Albinus (62 CE), Josephus included the story of the stoning of James, the brother of Jesus
rfrg-05-c1.claim: and the historian Josephus records the execution in 62 CE of "the brother of Jesus who was called Christ, whose name was James".
